_about: Transactions finalized on Solana mainnet, read on 2026-10-26 from https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com with getTransaction (encoding base64: 'transaction_base64' is the serialized transaction, signatures and message; encoding jsonParsed: 'parsed_message' and the token balances are the node's own reading of the same transaction) and, for the version-0 transaction, getAccountInfo (encoding base64) of each address lookup table it loads through. Nothing here is produced by nc-wallet-core. The first signature of each transaction verifies over its message with the fee payer's key.
